title: Fixes a regression introduced by the grub-common.service to
description:
Fixes a regression introduced by the grub-common.service to
grub2-common.service rename.

Problem:
grub-initrd-fallback.service and grub2-common.service both invoke
grub-editenv. The fallback service still orders itself after the removed
grub-common.service, so systemd can run both services concurrently. This can
produce "invalid environment block" errors and leave the system degraded.

Fix:
* Add an Ubuntu quilt patch ordering grub-initrd-fallback.service after
  grub2-common.service.
* Add a DEP-8 test verifying that both units are installed and that the
  ordering dependency references the active service name.

Validation:
* The complete quilt patch stack applies and unapplies successfully.
* The generated unit contains After=grub2-common.service.
* systemd-analyze verify, git diff --check, and shell syntax checks pass.
* A full binary package build and DEP-8 execution have not been run.

Related: LP: #1919121 and the previous ordering fix LP: #1910815.

Sponsorship requested.

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu-fix-grubenv-service-ordering.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+From: qixuan cao <caoqixuannimama@gmail.com>
+Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:09:55 +0800
+Subject: UBUNTU: serialize GRUB environment updates
+
+grub-initrd-fallback.service retained an ordering dependency on the removed
+grub-common.service after its replacement was renamed to
+grub2-common.service. Order the fallback service after the active service so
+their grub-editenv invocations cannot race while updating grubenv.
+
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/1919121
+Forwarded: not-needed
+---
+ grub-initrd-fallback.service | 2 +-
+ 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)
+
+diff --git a/grub-initrd-fallback.service b/grub-initrd-fallback.service
+index 59d1a62..4aab7f1 100644
+--- a/grub-initrd-fallback.service
++++ b/grub-initrd-fallback.service
+@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@
+ Description=GRUB failed boot detection
+ After=local-fs.target
+-After=grub-common.service
++After=grub2-common.service
+ After=sleep.target
+ ConditionPathExists=/boot/grub/grub.cfg
diff --git a/debian/tests/control b/debian/tests/control
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b19d011
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/control
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+Tests: systemd-service-ordering
+Depends: grub2-common, systemd
+Restrictions: superficial
diff --git a/debian/tests/systemd-service-ordering b/debian/tests/systemd-service-ordering
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..55f5004
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/systemd-service-ordering
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+
+set -eu
+
+unit_dir=/usr/lib/systemd/system
+fallback_unit="$unit_dir/grub-initrd-fallback.service"
+common_unit="$unit_dir/grub2-common.service"
+
+test -f "$fallback_unit"
+test -f "$common_unit"
+grep -Fxq 'After=grub2-common.service' "$fallback_unit"
